@dogeofficialceo As a $DOGE holder, I'd love it. But in all honesty, last I saw Dogecoin has a Nakoto score of 4. That's not decentralized enough to guarantee immutablity of government records. 

$DOGE will make a great payment system. But it isn't the best chain for this purpose.
